annotations.title: Truck load profit: take, counter or reject

description: [Kyreos, 0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Give a load offer (rate, loaded and deadhead miles) and your cost per mile, or fuel price, mpg and fixed costs. Returns profit, margin, all-in rate per mile, break-even rate and a counter-offer price for your target margin. Input: {"rate_usd":2400,"loaded_miles":1000,"deadhead_miles":150,"cpm":1.85,"target_margin":0.15}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/truck-load-profit?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.01 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.
